author: Adam Conover
title: You don’t have to be an alcoholic to experience the harms of drinking

author: Adam Conover
description:
Alcohol kills more Americans each year than all other drugs combined. So why aren't we treating it like the public health crisis that it is? Today I'm talking to health journalists Lev Facher and Isabella Cueto to unpack how it harms us, who benefits, and what we can do about it.
